item.description: 25 February 2026 The Flight Sim Awards 2026 event at this year's FSWeekend at the Aviodrome Lelystad in The Netherlands will once again celebrate the developers, creators and innovators who continually strive to push the limits of what we can enjoy in the virtual skies. These awards will recognise the absolute best in flight simulation and the winners will be revealed live in Lelystad at the Captain’s Dinner on Friday March 20.
